title: Ecommerce Growth Marketing Paid Media Specialist
description:
We are a DTC Growth Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses grow profitably.


Our Values:

- Treat others the way we want to be treated.

- Pay close attention to detail.

- Don't neglect the small things, they matter.

- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator.

- Have the confidence and determination to achieve our shared vision.


Who We Are Looking For:


We are looking for an ecommerce Paid Media Specialist who has experience managing large ad budgets across Meta and Google primarily. (Ideally over 1 million dollars USD per month). Additionally, if you experience using MTAs such as NorthBeam, incrementality testing tools, and MMM tools for data validation that is a major plus.


The candidate selected for this role would come in and manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts for US based ecommerce brands. We have a lot of high-profile ecommerce clients that we work with and we are looking for a seasoned Paid Media Specialist who can produce high quality results for our clients.


The right candidate will be task-oriented, analytical, and willing to keep the team and ad accounts on pace to make sure we are meeting or exceeding client expectations. A self-starter who can see problems and go to work fixing them and not be just an order taker. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing Facebook Ads and Google Ads for US based ecommerce brands.


Must have a portfolio of work that demonstrates the results that you have been able to provide and the KPIs you have hit. Must also demonstrate your skills with creative testing through media buying on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok ads.


Responsibilities

  • Manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts of US based ecommerce brands
  • Run ad campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok
  • Monitor ROAS, ad budgets, revenue, and core KPIs to optimize campaigns and achieve the desired results for our clients
  • Run profitable creative testing campaigns and identify trends to be able to communicate with the client what is working and what we should be creating more of
  • Create performance marketing reports for the accounts that you are managing to accurately display the analytics, results, and next steps
  • Strategize on ways to improve the overall marketing strategy for our brands to increase effectiveness
  • Maintain awareness of current industry and technology standards, social media, competitive landscape, and market trends


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field OR 3-4 years of experience OR alternative education experience (mentors or courses)
  • Prior experience working for an ecommerce brand or advertising agency is preferred
  • Must be proficient in Facebook & Google Ads management for ecommerce brands
  • Must be proficient in scaling ad budgets
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, and a hunger to always provide great results for our clients
  • Autonomous worker with an analytical mind
  • Portfolio of work, results, or case studies
  • You should be comfortable using some internal communication tools such as Monday.com, Google Drive, Zoom, and Slack for team meetings and to support other team members with any technical request. Experience with Monday.com or Asana is not required but please let us know if you have used it before or not.
  • You should also be confident enough to push back on the leadership team and express your opinion if you think the ship is heading off course. We encourage that.


Compensation:

  • $2000 - $8000 USD per month


Just as a disclaimer, please don't use AI or ChatGPT during the screening or interview process. We use a screening tool that can detect AI in your answers and during interviews. Using AI will result in your application being immediately disqualified.

  • Prior experience working for an ecommerce brand or advertising agency is preferred
  • Must be proficient in Facebook & Google Ads management for ecommerce brands
  • Must be proficient in scaling ad budgets
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, and a hunger to always provide great results for our clients
  • Autonomous worker with an analytical mind
  • Portfolio of work, results, or case studies
  • You should be comfortable using some internal communication tools such as Monday.com, Google Drive, Zoom, and Slack for team meetings and to support other team members with any technical request. Experience with Monday.com or Asana is not required but please let us know if you have used it before or not.
  • You should also be confident enough to push back on the leadership team and express your opinion if you think the ship is heading off course. We encourage that.


Compensation:

  • $2000 - $8000 USD per month


Just as a disclaimer, please don't use AI or ChatGPT during the screening or interview process. We use a screening tool that can detect AI in your answers and during interviews. Using AI will result in your application being immediately disqualified.

title: Human Resources Specialist

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.

  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.

Required Skills

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload

  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills

title: Consultor Salesforce - Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 59063


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei #fera em salesforce, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um(a) #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Administração e configuração do Salesforce CRM, com atuação em Lightning Applications e desenvolvimento de páginas e componentes (Lightning), além da implementação de Workflows, Approvals, Flows, Reports e Dashboards. Atuação em atividades de Admin, Admin Advanced, App Builder e consultoria.


  • Utilização de ferramentas da plataforma Force.com , incluindo Force.com Explorer, Change Sets, Import Wizard e Excel Connector, com operação em ambientes Sandbox e Production, além do uso de Visual Studio, IntelliJ e Salesforce Inspector.


  • Execução de rotinas de integração e manipulação de dados com Apex Data Loader, Import Wizard, Data Export e Mass Delete, bem como validação de integrações via Postman. Aplicação de consultas e extrações de dados utilizando SQL, SOQL e SOSL .


  • Certificações Salesforce: mandatório Administrator e Platform App Builder ; desejável Service Cloud Consultant, Sales Cloud Consultant, Experience Cloud Consultant e Advanced Administrator.


  • Inglês avançado para atuar em time Global.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira!


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Research Engineer, RL Environments
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, RL Environments to help design and build frontier-quality RL environments, reward systems, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems

  • Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria.
  • Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals.
  • Build reward functions, verifiers, automatic validators, and evaluation harnesses that provide reliable training signal and resist gaming.
  • Define environment interfaces: APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, and simulator-like dynamics that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build quality systems that keep environments robust at scale

  • Audit environments and trajectories for subtle failure modes: reward hacking, leakage, ambiguity, distribution shifts, and degenerate task distributions.
  • Implement automated validation: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, difficulty controls, and diversity monitoring.
  • Develop synthetic task generation and augmentation pipelines: programmatic generators, controlled perturbations, hard negatives, and scenario templating with diversity constraints.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals reflecting customer-intended model capabilities.
  • Produce analysis connecting environment design choices to training outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which environment and reward attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run RL or fine-tuning experiments (or partner with research) to validate that your environments produce measurable improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops based on trajectory analysis and quantitative signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task and environment creation efforts.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning or RL systems where environment design, data quality, or reward engineering mattered materially.
  • Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning — any of: environment/gym development, reward design, PPO/GRPO/DPO, trajectory collection, or RL training infrastructure.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good training task: verifiability, appropriate difficulty, resistance to shortcuts, and realistic constraints.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented in diagnosing subtle quality issues and failure modes in data or environments.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning RL training objectives into concrete environment specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, or constitutional AI methods.
  • Experience building custom gym environments, simulators, or distributed RL training systems.
  • Agentic evaluation: tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis.
  • Systems thinking: ability to simulate an application's API and data schema and design tasks reflecting real-world constraints.
  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Research Engineer, RL Environments
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, RL Environments to help design and build frontier-quality RL environments, reward systems, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems

  • Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria.
  • Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals.
  • Build reward functions, verifiers, automatic validators, and evaluation harnesses that provide reliable training signal and resist gaming.
  • Define environment interfaces: APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, and simulator-like dynamics that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build quality systems that keep environments robust at scale

  • Audit environments and trajectories for subtle failure modes: reward hacking, leakage, ambiguity, distribution shifts, and degenerate task distributions.
  • Implement automated validation: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, difficulty controls, and diversity monitoring.
  • Develop synthetic task generation and augmentation pipelines: programmatic generators, controlled perturbations, hard negatives, and scenario templating with diversity constraints.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals reflecting customer-intended model capabilities.
  • Produce analysis connecting environment design choices to training outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which environment and reward attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run RL or fine-tuning experiments (or partner with research) to validate that your environments produce measurable improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops based on trajectory analysis and quantitative signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task and environment creation efforts.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning or RL systems where environment design, data quality, or reward engineering mattered materially.
  • Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning — any of: environment/gym development, reward design, PPO/GRPO/DPO, trajectory collection, or RL training infrastructure.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good training task: verifiability, appropriate difficulty, resistance to shortcuts, and realistic constraints.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented in diagnosing subtle quality issues and failure modes in data or environments.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning RL training objectives into concrete environment specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, or constitutional AI methods.
  • Experience building custom gym environments, simulators, or distributed RL training systems.
  • Agentic evaluation: tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis.
  • Systems thinking: ability to simulate an application's API and data schema and design tasks reflecting real-world constraints.
  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Build AI-Powered Computer-Vision Products with Us


Our company specializes in AI-driven computer vision solutions for the wood industry, enhancing production efficiency and sustainability. Collaborating with the world's leading sawmills, we play a pivotal role in supporting the shift to a carbon-neutral future. Our focus is on innovation and technology, fostering automation to minimize waste.


We work in small, highly skilled teams that embody a startup-like mentality, embracing diverse cultures from Belgium, Romania, Spain, and Brazil. As a horizontal organization, we value initiative and self-drive. Our development team boasts members with over 15 years of experience, including key figures such as founding members and team leads who have successfully guided startups to exits exceeding 150 million dollars.


We're Looking for You!


Are you excited to learn and grow in a fast-paced tech environment? Do you want to work with experienced professionals who can mentor you? If yes, we'd love to have you join our team.


Your Role:


  • Work in an Agile environment with a team of experienced developers, researchers, and business analysts
  • Architect and develop highly performant software components, with an emphasis on scalability and robustness
  • Build back-end components for web-based applications built around the product
  • Actively participate with ideas for improving the product
  • Write automated tests and document your code
  • Participate in code review sessions
  • Engage in knowledge transfer and coaching sessions – you’ll have the opportunity to understand how the entire ecosystem works and contribute to components of the project which you might be interested in – AI, computer vision, HPC.
  • Work and innovate with R&D to integrate research results into the final product


What We Need from You:


Every Neural Grader team member is an important asset to us and makes their mark on the projects they’re working on. Here is what we’re looking for in this role:


  • Technical Bachelor's degree
  • Have a very high understanding of OOP concepts and comprehensive knowledge across programming fields
  • Self-driven and able to drive tasks to completion independently
  • Pragmatic and goal-oriented
  • Very good technical knowledge and work experience with Java, Spring Boot, JPA, SQL
  • Ability to architect complex features, focusing on performance
  • Image processing/computer vision skills are a plus


What We Offer


  • Flat structure—initiative beats hierarchy
  • Competitive salary
  • Training, coaching, and certifications
  • Periodic performance evaluations
  • Performance or special occasion bonuses
  • Remote work
  • Team buildings
  • Plus, a high-tech lab with industrial cameras and lasers


Ready to Apply?

We're excited to hear from you! Send us your application and let's start the conversation about your future with us.

title: CRO & Marketing Specialist (UX, Content Writing)
description:
Company Description

We are Charly, a growing digital agency specializing in web design, UX/UI, branding, ecommerce, and development for clients primarily in the US. Our team is spread across Europe and Latin America and we are scaling fast.

We are looking for a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Specialist who is passionate about websites, data, and improving performance. This role will focus on analyzing user behavior, identifying conversion bottlenecks, and implementing structured experimentation to improve lead generation and sales performance across our client projects.

You will work closely with our Project Managers, designers, developers, and leadership team to ensure that the websites we build are not only visually strong but also optimized to convert.


Your Core Responsibilities

  • Conduct CRO audits for client websites and landing pages to identify friction points, funnel drop-offs, and conversion barriers
  • Analyze user behavior using tools such as Google Analytics, Tag Manager, heatmaps, and session recordings
  • Identify issues related to checkout abandonment, form drop-offs, mobile UX problems, trust gaps, and messaging clarity
  • Design and implement structured A/B or multivariate experiments to improve conversion performance
  • Optimize key elements including headlines, CTAs, layouts, forms, product pages, and landing pages
  • Prepare structured audit reports with prioritized recommendations based on potential revenue impact
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and PMs to implement CRO improvements across active client projects
  • Join client and sales calls when necessary to explain CRO strategies, findings, and experiment results in clear, non-technical language
  • Continuously refine optimization strategies as new data and experiment results become available


Who this role is perfect for:

  • Someone with strong analytical thinking who can translate data into clear action steps
  • Someone who understands both UX and marketing psychology behind conversions
  • Someone comfortable running experiments and interpreting results
  • Someone who enjoys working with websites, funnels, and digital products
  • Someone proactive who can identify improvement opportunities without waiting for direction
  • Someone comfortable collaborating with designers, developers, and project managers in a remote team environment
  • Someone fluent in English and confident communicating with clients
  • Based in Latin America


What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote role in a growing digital agency
  • Flexible work environment with a distributed international team
  • Opportunity to work on multiple websites and client projects across different industries
  • Direct collaboration with leadership, PMs, designers, and developers
  • Long-term role with the opportunity to shape CRO processes as the agency scales


To Apply:

To apply, send your CV and a 1-minute video introducing yourself and your experience to with the subject line:


\"CRO & Marketing Specialist Application - (Your Full Name)\"


In your video, briefly cover who you are, your marketing and CRO background, and one result or project you are proud of.



⚠️ Applications submitted via LinkedIn will NOT be considered. Please ensure you meet the listed qualifications before applying.

title: Research Engineer, Multimodal
description:
The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Multimodal to help deliver frontier-quality multimodal datasets, evaluations, and RL environments that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.


This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their multimodal model improvement goals into concrete data specs — designing tasks that test genuine cross-modal reasoning, not just text comprehension with images attached.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building or improving multimodal AI systems — especially where strong results depended on data curation across modalities, evaluation design, or building systems that handle the complexity of real-world documents, charts, and visual interfaces.


What You'll Do

1. Design and deliver multimodal datasets and evaluation environments

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for multimodal capabilities: chart reading, document QA, UI understanding, diagram-based reasoning, OCR-aware tasks, and visual grounding.
  • Design task suites that test true multimodal reasoning — tasks where the answer requires integrating information across text, images, tables, and document structure, not just surface-level pattern matching.
  • Build ground-truth signals and verification systems for multimodal tasks, where correctness often depends on spatial relationships, visual context, and cross-reference between modalities.
  • Define task formats and data schemas that capture the full richness of multimodal inputs while remaining tractable for model training.


2. Build quality and validation systems for multimodal data

  • Perform deep audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors in visual grounding, incorrect chart readings, OCR artifacts, layout misinterpretations, and ambiguous visual references.
  • Implement automated validation: consistency checks across modalities, format and schema validation, deduplication, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic data generation pipelines: programmatic chart/table generation, document layout templating, controlled visual perturbations, and augmentation across visual conditions.

3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals targeting multimodal capabilities aligned with customer goals.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted multimodal tasks, error breakdowns by modality and task type, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable multimodal improvement.

4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, visual examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in multimodal quality metrics.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale multimodal data creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for cross-modal correctness and realism.


Who We're Looking For

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving AI systems involving multimodal data — images, documents, charts, tables, or visual interfaces combined with text.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of: document understanding, chart/diagram reasoning, OCR systems, UI understanding, or vision-language models.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good multimodal task: genuine cross-modal reasoning requirements, clear ground truth, and resistance to text-only shortcuts.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented — you catch when a chart label is misread, a table cell is misaligned, or a visual reference is ambiguous.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning multimodal model goals into concrete data specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • RL or post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design applied to multimodal tasks.
  • Experience with vision-language models (CLIP, LLaVA, GPT-4V, Gemini, or equivalent).
  • Agentic evaluation involving visual grounding: browser-use agents, UI navigation, or screen-based task completion.
  • Experience building evaluation frameworks or benchmarks for multimodal systems.
  • Audio/video understanding experience (optional but valued).


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the multimodal datasets and evaluations training the next generation of vision-language models.
  • Real impact: your data will directly shape how models learn to read charts, understand documents, navigate interfaces, and reason across modalities.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Research Engineer, Multimodal
description:
The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Multimodal to help deliver frontier-quality multimodal datasets, evaluations, and RL environments that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.


This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their multimodal model improvement goals into concrete data specs — designing tasks that test genuine cross-modal reasoning, not just text comprehension with images attached.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building or improving multimodal AI systems — especially where strong results depended on data curation across modalities, evaluation design, or building systems that handle the complexity of real-world documents, charts, and visual interfaces.


What You'll Do

1. Design and deliver multimodal datasets and evaluation environments

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for multimodal capabilities: chart reading, document QA, UI understanding, diagram-based reasoning, OCR-aware tasks, and visual grounding.
  • Design task suites that test true multimodal reasoning — tasks where the answer requires integrating information across text, images, tables, and document structure, not just surface-level pattern matching.
  • Build ground-truth signals and verification systems for multimodal tasks, where correctness often depends on spatial relationships, visual context, and cross-reference between modalities.
  • Define task formats and data schemas that capture the full richness of multimodal inputs while remaining tractable for model training.


2. Build quality and validation systems for multimodal data

  • Perform deep audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors in visual grounding, incorrect chart readings, OCR artifacts, layout misinterpretations, and ambiguous visual references.
  • Implement automated validation: consistency checks across modalities, format and schema validation, deduplication, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic data generation pipelines: programmatic chart/table generation, document layout templating, controlled visual perturbations, and augmentation across visual conditions.

3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals targeting multimodal capabilities aligned with customer goals.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted multimodal tasks, error breakdowns by modality and task type, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable multimodal improvement.

4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, visual examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in multimodal quality metrics.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale multimodal data creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for cross-modal correctness and realism.


Who We're Looking For

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving AI systems involving multimodal data — images, documents, charts, tables, or visual interfaces combined with text.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of: document understanding, chart/diagram reasoning, OCR systems, UI understanding, or vision-language models.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good multimodal task: genuine cross-modal reasoning requirements, clear ground truth, and resistance to text-only shortcuts.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented — you catch when a chart label is misread, a table cell is misaligned, or a visual reference is ambiguous.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning multimodal model goals into concrete data specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • RL or post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design applied to multimodal tasks.
  • Experience with vision-language models (CLIP, LLaVA, GPT-4V, Gemini, or equivalent).
  • Agentic evaluation involving visual grounding: browser-use agents, UI navigation, or screen-based task completion.
  • Experience building evaluation frameworks or benchmarks for multimodal systems.
  • Audio/video understanding experience (optional but valued).


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the multimodal datasets and evaluations training the next generation of vision-language models.
  • Real impact: your data will directly shape how models learn to read charts, understand documents, navigate interfaces, and reason across modalities.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

  • Competitive compensation

title: Gerente de produtos sênior
description:
A Listenx é líder em Music Branding na América latina.


Atuamos no modelo SAAS combinando tecnologia, música e anúncios no ponto de vendas para entregar comunicação estratégica e experiências musicais que fidelizam clientes e aumentam vendas.


Com soluções para todos os tamanhos de empresas, a Listenx está presente em mais de 16.000 clientes de todos os tamanhos no Brasil e América latina.


Somos apaixonados por música, tecnologia e inovação , crescemos em ritmo acelerado e estamos buscando pessoas para construir essa jornada junto com a gente.


✔️Sua missão:

Liderar a estratégia e a execução do produto, garantindo alinhamento entre visão de negócio, necessidades dos clientes e capacidade técnica.

Responsável por maximizar geração de valor, crescimento de receita recorrente, retenção e escalabilidade da plataforma SaaS, estruturando processos e promovendo cultura orientada a resultados.


✔️Responsabilidades:

• Definir e evoluir a estratégia de produto alinhada ao planejamento da empresa.

• Construir e gerir o roadmap com base em impacto, dados e validação com clientes.

• Liderar times de Produto, UX/UI e Engenharia com foco em performance e responsabilidade por resultados.

• Conduzir discovery contínuo para gerar crescimento, retenção e vantagem competitiva.

• Garantir entregas com qualidade, previsibilidade e foco em impacto, utilizando métodos ágeis.

• Monitorar e otimizar indicadores de produto e receita.

• Integrar Produto com Vendas, Marketing e Customer Success para crescimento sustentável.

• Estruturar governança, processos e rituais da área.

• Gerir orçamento e apoiar decisões estratégicas de investimento e alocação de recursos.


✔️Requisitos e Diferenciais:

• Experiência acima de 6 anos em cargos de gestão na área de produto, preferencialmente em empresas de tecnologia

• Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

• Experiência com definição de roadmap, discovery, product-market fit e escalabilidade de produto.

• Vivência comprovada na liderança de times técnicos e multidisciplinares.

• Sólidos conhecimentos técnicos para dialogar com Engenharia (arquitetura, APIs, integrações, cloud)

• Será um diferencial ter atuado no modelo de negócio de tecnologia (Saas)


✔️O que esperamos de você:

• Visão estratégica

• Tomada de decisão baseada em dados

• Comunicação clara e objetiva

• Capacidade analítica e orientação a métricas

• Trabalho em equipe


✔️Benefícios:

  • Vale Transporte ou Vale Combustível

title: Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description:
This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native iOS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.


FlyMeOut is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.


We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.


What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.js/TypeScript backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.


Day to day, you'll be working on things like:

  • Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with TypeScript
  • Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
  • Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
  • Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
  • Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
  • Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team


You should have:

  • 5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
  • Strong experience with Expo, TypeScript, and modern state management (TanStack Query, Zustand, or similar)
  • Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
  • Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
  • Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome


Nice to have:

  • Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms

title: Tech Lead
description:
A Teddy Open Finance está em busca de um profissional talentoso e motivado para se juntar à nossa equipe. Se você deseja fazer parte do futuro do setor financeiro, venha para o nosso time.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Liderar e orientar equipes de desenvolvedores, interagindo com múltiplas Squads para garantir o sucesso dos produtos/projetos;
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter sistemas utilizando Nodejs e outras tecnologias relevantes;
  • Gerenciar sistemas de mensageria, incluindo Kafka ou RabbitMQ, para suportar processos de integração e entrega de dados;
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de arquitetura e design;
  • Garantir a qualidade do código e dos produtos;
  • Avaliar e otimizar o desempenho dos aplicativos e sistemas;
  • Apoiar na evolução da esteira DevOps;
  • Apoiar infra na gestão de custo da AWS;
  • Contribuir para planejamento de solução junto ao time de produto e design.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software com Nodejs;
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de aplicações em nuvem ambiente AWS;
  • Conhecimento em mensageria Kafka, RabbitMQ, Etc;
  • Experiência em git e gitflow;
  • Experiência em liderança de equipes;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de software em escala e Micro serviços;
  • Experiência em ambientes de DevOps;
  • Ter atuado em squads e métodos ágeis;
  • Conhecimento nas ferramentas da Atlassian como Jira e Confluence.


Diferenciais :

  • Conhecimento em Front End e em outras linguagens;
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados MySQL, PostGree, Redis, MongoDB.


Benefícios

  • Vale alimentação
  • Vale refeição
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Alura
  • FIAP
  • Total Pass
  • Programa de orientação pessoal - C4 Life
  • Day Off

title: Senior Network Security Engineer
description:
The Network Security Engineer is responsible for protecting an organization’s networks and data from cyber threats. This role involves designing, implementing, and maintaining security infrastructure (firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, VPNs, etc.) and monitoring the network for vulnerabilities or incidents. The engineer will play a critical role in upholding Zero Trust security principles and ensuring high availability and integrity of network services in a dynamic, cloud-enabled environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Security Infrastructure Management: Configure, deploy, and maintain network security systems (firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN gateways, encryption devices) to safeguard internal networks and cloud environments.
  • Threat Monitoring & Incident Response: Monitor network traffic and logs for suspicious activities; promptly investigate and respond to security incidents or breaches to minimize impact.
  • Vulnerability Assessment: Conduct regular security audits, vulnerability scans, and penetration tests to identify and remediate network weaknesses. Implement patches and updates to address vulnerabilities and ensure systems are protected against emerging threats.
  • Access Control & Policies: Enforce access controls and network segmentation (supporting a Zero Trust Network Access model) by administering firewalls and network access control lists. Develop and update network security policies, standards, and procedures to align with best practices and compliance requirements.
  • Collaboration & Advisory: Work closely with IT infrastructure teams, application developers, and security architects to integrate security measures into new projects and systems. Provide guidance on secure network design and educate team members on security best practices.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain detailed documentation of configurations, incidents, and changes. Ensure all network security measures comply with relevant regulations and industry standards (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS) and assist in preparing for security audits.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • Technical Skills: Strong understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, etc.) and hands-on experience with network security technologies (firewalls such as Palo Alto/Cisco/Fortinet, IDS/IPS, VPN solutions, SIEM tools). Proficiency in configuring and managing firewalls and routing/switching equipment in complex networks.
  • Security Expertise: Knowledge of cybersecurity principles , threat landscape, and best practices (e.g., Zero Trust architecture, defense-in-depth, encryption, secure network design ). Ability to perform log analysis, intrusion detection, malware analysis basics, and incident handling.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for diagnosing network and security issues. Ability to respond effectively under pressure during security incidents or outages.
  • Communication & Teamwork: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders, and provide user training or guidance on security policies when needed.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced/Cloud Security: Experience with cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP networking and security services) or secure network design in hybrid cloud environments . Familiarity with SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) frameworks or software-defined networking is a plus.
  • Automation & Scripting: Scripting or automation skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell) to automate network/security tasks and improve efficiency in security operations.
  • Advanced Education: Master’s degree in Cybersecurity or Information Systems.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in network security, cybersecurity engineering, or a related IT infrastructure security role. Proven track record implementing and managing firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs, and performing security monitoring and incident response in an enterprise or managed services environment.

Certifications:

  • Industry Certifications: Professional certifications are highly advantageous . Preferred certifications include CISSP, CISM (for security management knowledge) or CEH, GIAC (for technical security skills). Vendor-specific certifications such as Palo Alto Networks PCNSE/PCNSA are also valuable and demonstrate expertise in relevant technologies.

title: Senior Network Security Engineer
description:
The Network Security Engineer is responsible for protecting an organization’s networks and data from cyber threats. This role involves designing, implementing, and maintaining security infrastructure (firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, VPNs, etc.) and monitoring the network for vulnerabilities or incidents. The engineer will play a critical role in upholding Zero Trust security principles and ensuring high availability and integrity of network services in a dynamic, cloud-enabled environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Security Infrastructure Management: Configure, deploy, and maintain network security systems (firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN gateways, encryption devices) to safeguard internal networks and cloud environments.
  • Threat Monitoring & Incident Response: Monitor network traffic and logs for suspicious activities; promptly investigate and respond to security incidents or breaches to minimize impact.
  • Vulnerability Assessment: Conduct regular security audits, vulnerability scans, and penetration tests to identify and remediate network weaknesses. Implement patches and updates to address vulnerabilities and ensure systems are protected against emerging threats.
  • Access Control & Policies: Enforce access controls and network segmentation (supporting a Zero Trust Network Access model) by administering firewalls and network access control lists. Develop and update network security policies, standards, and procedures to align with best practices and compliance requirements.
  • Collaboration & Advisory: Work closely with IT infrastructure teams, application developers, and security architects to integrate security measures into new projects and systems. Provide guidance on secure network design and educate team members on security best practices.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain detailed documentation of configurations, incidents, and changes. Ensure all network security measures comply with relevant regulations and industry standards (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS) and assist in preparing for security audits.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • Technical Skills: Strong understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, etc.) and hands-on experience with network security technologies (firewalls such as Palo Alto/Cisco/Fortinet, IDS/IPS, VPN solutions, SIEM tools). Proficiency in configuring and managing firewalls and routing/switching equipment in complex networks.
  • Security Expertise: Knowledge of cybersecurity principles , threat landscape, and best practices (e.g., Zero Trust architecture, defense-in-depth, encryption, secure network design ). Ability to perform log analysis, intrusion detection, malware analysis basics, and incident handling.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for diagnosing network and security issues. Ability to respond effectively under pressure during security incidents or outages.
  • Communication & Teamwork: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders, and provide user training or guidance on security policies when needed.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced/Cloud Security: Experience with cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP networking and security services) or secure network design in hybrid cloud environments . Familiarity with SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) frameworks or software-defined networking is a plus.
  • Automation & Scripting: Scripting or automation skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell) to automate network/security tasks and improve efficiency in security operations.
  • Advanced Education: Master’s degree in Cybersecurity or Information Systems.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in network security, cybersecurity engineering, or a related IT infrastructure security role. title: Product Owner Pleno (PO)
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um(a) Super Product Owner Pleno , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Produtos e que queria crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades:

Estratégia e visão de produto

  • Contribuir para a definição da visão do produto e alinhamento com stakeholders;
  • Identificar problemas relevantes e oportunidades de melhoria baseadas em dados e feedback de usuários;
  • Priorizar iniciativas alinhadas aos OKRs trimestrais.


Discovery e validação de soluções

  • Conduzir discovery contínuo para entendimento profundo de problemas e necessidades;
  • Criar e validar hipóteses de solução antes da implementação em escala;
  • Construir ou apoiar a construção de MVPs rápidos utilizando ferramentas de IA, prototipação e low-code;
  • Testar soluções com usuários antes de direcionar o time de engenharia.


Gestão do produto e delivery

  • Criar épicos e histórias de usuário bem estruturadas, com critérios de aceite claros;
  • Gerir backlog upstream e downstream;
  • Priorizar e refinar demandas com o time de tecnologia;
  • Orientar o time sobre regras de negócio e objetivos das entregas;
  • Avaliar e aceitar entregas garantindo aderência aos critérios definidos.


Colaboração com o time

  • Trabalhar próximo aos times de UX, Engenharia e Dados;
  • Participar de rituais do time (dailys, refinamentos, planning e retrospectivas);
  • Garantir clareza de contexto e objetivos para o time multidisciplinar.


Gestão por dados

  • Monitorar métricas de produto e comportamento do usuário;
  • Utilizar dados para validar hipóteses e apoiar decisões de produto;
  • Conduzir experimentos (A/B tests, testes de solução, validações rápidas).


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida atuando como Product Manager ou Product Owner;
  • Forte habilidade de priorização de backlog;
  • Experiência com Discovery e Delivery de produto;
  • Capacidade de estruturar histórias de usuário, critérios de aceite e cenários;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis como Scrum e Kanban;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de produto (Jira, Miro ou similares);
  • Experiência com análise de dados de produto (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Google Analytics, HubSpot ou similares);
  • Experiência com testes e experimentação em produtos digitais;
  • Experiência com métricas de produto digital.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em estatística ou ciência de dados;
  • Noções de arquitetura e stacks de tecnologia (backend, web, app, infraestrutura);
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou marketplaces;
  • Experiência em startups;
  • Experiência com prototipação rápida e ferramentas de construção low-code / IA.


O que esperamos dessa pessoa:

  • Forte orientação a resolver problemas reais dos usuários ;
  • Mentalidade data-driven ;
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões com autonomia e responsabilidade ;
  • Perfil mão na massa , confortável em testar soluções rapidamente;
  • Curiosidade e abertura para trabalhar com IA e novas ferramentas de construção de produto ;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de colaboração com times multidisciplinares.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.



O que oferecemos:

  • Ambiente Cloud (AWS)
  • Contato prévio com AWS Glue, Athena e S3
  • Não é necessário domínio avançado, mas é importante já ter vivenciado ambientes em nuvem
  • Python para análise e manipulação de dados

  • SQL Server
  • Experiência com procedures, funções e views

title: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP CPI - Plenio/Sênior
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Estamos em busca de um profissional qualificado para atuar na integração de sistemas SAP, garantindo conectividade eficiente entre diferentes plataformas e aplicações empresariais. O candidato ideal terá experiência em arquiteturas de integração, desenvolvimento de interfaces e uso de ferramentas específicas do ecossistema SAP, e deve ter inglês em nível avançado para atuação em projetos internacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter integrações entre o SAP e outros sistemas (internos e externos).
  • Trabalhar com middleware e tecnologias de integração como SAP PI/PO, SAP CPI, BTP, API Management e Web Services (SOAP/REST).
  • Implementar e monitorar processos de troca de dados via IDocs, RFCs, OData e BAPIs.
  • Garantir a segurança, escalabilidade e eficiência das integrações.
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e negócio para alinhar soluções às necessidades estratégicas da empresa.
  • Identificar e solucionar problemas de integração, otimizando processos e garantindo alta disponibilidade.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica e boas práticas de integração.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência comprovada com integração de sistemas SAP.
  • Conhecimento avançado em SAP PI/PO, SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration), API Management e Web Services.
  • Experiência com IDocs, RFCs, OData e BAPIs.
  • Familiaridade com protocolos de comunicação e formatos de dados como XML, JSON, EDIFACT e CSV.
  • Conhecimento em ABAP, Java, JavaScript ou Groovy para customizações de integração.
  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a serviços (SOA) e microsserviços.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente para atuação em projetos internacionais.


Diferenciais (Desejável):


  • Certificações SAP em integração (ex.: SAP Certified Development Associate - SAP Integration Suite).
  • Experiência com SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform).
  • Conhecimento em integrações com SAP S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, Ariba, C/4HANA e outras soluções SAP.


Regime de contratação: CLT

100% Remoto


Liberte todo o seu potencial e engenhosidade – molde o seu próprio futuro. Somos mais do que apenas um local de trabalho; somos uma incubadora de talentos. Com diversos caminhos e oportunidades de aprendizado e carreira de longo prazo, oferecemos inúmeras maneiras de realizar seus sonhos.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Senior Carrier Business Development Executive
description:
China Mobile International Limited (CMI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Mobile. In order to provide better services to meet the growing demand in the international telecommunications market, China Mobile established CMI in December 2010, headquartered in Hong Kong, China. CMI has expanded its footprint in 39 countries and regions.

Leveraging the strong support by China Mobile, CMI is a trusted partner that provides comprehensive international information services and solutions to international enterprises, carriers and mobile users.


We are looking for a dynamic and proactive Senior Carrier Business Development Executive to join our team.


This role is responsible for driving business growth through new customer acquisition, account management, and strategic carrier partnerships across Voice, A2P messaging, and eSIM mobility products. The position plays a critical role in expanding market penetration, optimizing commercial conditions, and ensuring smooth operational execution in close collaboration with internal, regional, and HQ teams.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish, develop, and expand business relationships with customers and partners across Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility products, driving new revenue opportunities and account growth.
  • Define and execute sales and business development strategies, managing a structured sales pipeline by customer account and region to achieve revenue and market penetration targets.
  • Manage customer accounts end to end, including commercial negotiations, daily operational follow-up, service performance review, and after-sales support.
  • Develop and manage strategic relationships with global Voice, A2P, and mobile carriers, leading negotiations to secure competitive pricing, routing, capacity, and commercial terms.
  • Lead carrier and customer contract execution, including onboarding, implementation, performance monitoring, and renewals.
  • Monitor market trends, customer needs, and carrier performance to identify growth, optimization, and partnership opportunities.
  • Support the optimization of Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility supply networks, ensuring service continuity, cost efficiency, and scalability.
  • Work closely with internal commercial, technical, and operational teams to ensure smooth end-to-end execution from opportunity identification to service activation.
  • Collaborate with HQ and regional teams to align on sales targets, partnership strategies, and overall business performance.
  • Analyze commercial and operational performance and prepare sales and performance reports for management review.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid telecommunications experience in the LATAM market.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.


Preferred Requirements:

  • Advanced to fluent proficiency in Spanish or Mandarin Chinese.

title: Data Engineer Powercenter (Realocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • +3years of experience as a Data Engineer with Informatica PowerCenter .
  • Strong knowledge of ETL processes and development of complex workflows and data pipelines.
  • Experience with Informatica Cloud / CDI-PC / IICS , including design, implementation, and maintenance of cloud data integration pipelines .
  • Experience in developing integrated solutions and creating complex workflows in a corporate data environment.
  • Ability to plan, monitor, and deliver projects within timelines and budget.
  • Experience in testing, data quality, and defect management.
  • Good command of English.
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal (Porto or Lisbon); eligible for a Portuguese work visa or holding EU/dual nationality.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote based in Portugal/on-site.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - . title: Dental Insurance Posting Agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.


As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you’ll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You’ll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.


About iCore


iCore is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.

We are more than a software company. iCoreConnect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.

Behind iCoreConnect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We’re proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.


Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.


Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.


Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.


Objectives:


  • Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
  • Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
  • Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
  • Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
  • Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
  • Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
  • Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
  • Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
  • Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns


Competencies:

  • Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
  • Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
  • High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
  • Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
  • Full English proficiency
  • Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
  • Ability to pass job-specific assessments


Benefits:


Personal:

  • Be a valued leader, not just a trainer

You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.


  • Make a real difference at scale

Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices , and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.


  • Work with a mission-driven team

You’ll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.


  • 100% remote – work from home

Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.


  • Better work-life balance

While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.


  • Stability and long-term growth

Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.


Professional:

  • Grow your training and leadership skills

Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.


  • Work with industry leaders in dental

Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.


  • Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology

Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.


  • Build and lead teams

Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.


  • Expand your industry network

Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.


  • Develop enterprise-level experience

Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.


What you can expect from a career with our team!

  • Competitive hourly rate
  • Schedule: 8 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST
  • Commitment: Full-time, 40+ hours per week
  • Work Setup: Fully remote position


You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals.

If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!
