title: Independent M&A Partner
description:
Junte-se à Elite Global: Escale sua Prática de M&A no Coração Econômico da América Latina


Eleve sua assessoria ao aderir à rede de M&A internacional mais prestigiada do mundo.


O ONEtoONE Corporate Finance Group convida Partners de M&A, MDs e boutiques financeiras baseadas em São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro e nos hubs do Agronegócio a integrarem nossa rede de alto desempenho. Esta é uma oportunidade estratégica de parceria para profissionais independentes que desejam alavancar uma marca global e uma infraestrutura de banco de investimento de classe mundial.


Por que os Partners no Brasil estão escolhendo a ONEtoONE em 2026


O mercado brasileiro em 2026 exige sofisticação. Com a consolidação de setores como Saúde, Logística e Clean Energy , as empresas de médio porte (Middle Market) brasileiras tornaram-se alvos primordiais para o capital estrangeiro.


  • Presença Global, Autoridade Local: Conecte-se a mais de 150 assessores em 80+ cidades. Mantenha sua independência enquanto utiliza uma marca que liga a Faria Lima e o Leblon aos centros financeiros de Nova York, Frankfurt e Xangai.
  • A Ponte do Agronegócio e Tech: O Brasil lidera em Agtech, Fintech e Transição Energética . Utilize nossa tecnologia de IA proprietária para conectar empresas brasileiras a compradores estratégicos globais com precisão absoluta.
  • Sem Barreiras Geográficas: Não acreditamos em exclusividade territorial engessada. Quer esteja liderando um exit de tecnologia em Florianópolis, uma consolidação industrial no interior de SP ou um projeto de infraestrutura no Nordeste, você tem total liberdade global.


Um Back-Office de Elite ao seu Dispor


O mercado de 2026 não aceita amadorismo. Nós cuidamos da complexidade técnica para que você foque no relacionamento e na originação:


  • Suporte na Execução: Equipe especializada de analistas para confecção de Teasers, Infomemos e modelos financeiros complexos (DCF, LBO) do pitch ao closing.
  • Dados Globais: Acesso premium a 450 milhões de perfis de empresas e inteligência transacional em tempo real para garantir que seus valuations sejam inquestionáveis internacionalmente.
  • CRM de M&A Avançado: Um ecossistema digital desenhado para o Mid-Market, garantindo eficiência e total sigilo em cada transação.


Perfil Ideal do Partner


Buscamos líderes da comunidade financeira brasileira que possuam:


  • 10+ Anos de Experiência: Trajetória comprovada em Investment Banking, Private Equity ou Corporate Finance.
  • Rede Estratégica: Relacionamento sólido com donos de empresas, grupos familiares ou fundos de PE/VC.
  • Mentalidade Empreendedora: Desejo de gerir sua própria operação com o suporte de uma plataforma global.
  • Especialização Setorial: Conhecimento profundo em áreas como Agronegócio, Tecnologia, Saúde, Logística ou Energia.


Vantagens da Parceria


Colaboração Global: Acesso direto a partners em 80+ cidades para encontrar o comprador estratégico que paga o maior prêmio.

Crescimento de Receita: Estrutura transparente de divisão de fees que valoriza o esforço de originação e execução.

Tecnologia IA: Ferramentas exclusivas para identificar \"targets\" e compradores ideais antes da concorrência.

Escala Imediata: Infraestrutura de \"Big Bank\" sem o custo fixo e a burocracia das instituições tradicionais.


Pronto para Transformar sua Prática de M&A?


Se você está pronto para transformar sua assessoria local em uma potência global no vibrante mercado brasileiro de 2026, convidamos você a se candidatar. Vamos redefinir o futuro do M&A no Brasil.

title: Banco de Talentos GFT -  Engenharia de Dados
description:
Banco de Talentos | Engenharia de Dados


Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de Engenharia de Dados, em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead), que desejam atuar em projetos complexos, ambientes de alta volumetria e ecossistemas de dados modernos.


Se você busca desafios técnicos relevantes, trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados e construir soluções escaláveis, queremos te conhecer!


O que você poderá fazer por aqui

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis e eficientes;
  • Trabalhar com ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados (ETL/ELT);
  • Construir e evoluir arquiteturas de dados modernas (Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, Lakehouses);
  • Garantir qualidade, governança e confiabilidade dos dados;
  • Atuar com processamento de dados em batch e streaming;
  • Integrar diferentes fontes de dados e sistemas;
  • Colaborar com times de dados, analytics, produto e engenharia;
  • Contribuir com boas práticas de engenharia, performance e observabilidade de dados.


O que buscamos

  • Experiência com engenharia de dados e construção de pipelines;
  • Conhecimento em linguagens como Python, SQL e/ou Scala;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de processamento de dados (Spark, Databricks, etc.);
  • Vivência com orquestração de pipelines (Airflow, Prefect, ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados e otimização de consultas;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL;
  • Experiência com soluções de cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) voltadas a dados;
  • Familiaridade com mensageria e streaming (Kafka, Kinesis, etc.) é um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de Data Lake, Data Warehouse e arquitetura de dados;
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git) e boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Certificações em cloud ou dados (como AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, entre outras) serão consideradas um diferencial.


Perfil que valorizamos

  • Pensamento analítico e forte capacidade de resolução de problemas;
  • Proatividade e senso de dono sobre as soluções;
  • Colaboração com times multidisciplinares;
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos e em constante evolução;
  • Interesse por inovação, dados e novas tecnologias;
  • Organização e autonomia na gestão do trabalho.


Se identificou? Cadastre-se no nosso banco de talentos e fique por dentro das oportunidades que podem surgir

description:
Banco de Talentos | Engenharia de Dados


Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de Engenharia de Dados, em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead), que desejam atuar em projetos complexos, ambientes de alta volumetria e ecossistemas de dados modernos.


Se você busca desafios técnicos relevantes, trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados e construir soluções escaláveis, queremos te conhecer!


O que você poderá fazer por aqui

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis e eficientes;
  • Trabalhar com ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados (ETL/ELT);
  • Construir e evoluir arquiteturas de dados modernas (Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, Lakehouses);
  • Garantir qualidade, governança e confiabilidade dos dados;
  • Atuar com processamento de dados em batch e streaming;
  • Integrar diferentes fontes de dados e sistemas;
  • Colaborar com times de dados, analytics, produto e engenharia;
  • Contribuir com boas práticas de engenharia, performance e observabilidade de dados.


O que buscamos

  • Experiência com engenharia de dados e construção de pipelines;
  • Conhecimento em linguagens como Python, SQL e/ou Scala;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de processamento de dados (Spark, Databricks, etc.);
  • Vivência com orquestração de pipelines (Airflow, Prefect, ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados e otimização de consultas;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL;
  • Experiência com soluções de cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) voltadas a dados;
  • Familiaridade com mensageria e streaming (Kafka, Kinesis, etc.) é um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de Data Lake, Data Warehouse e arquitetura de dados;
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git) e boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Certificações em cloud ou dados (como AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, entre outras) serão consideradas um diferencial.


Perfil que valorizamos

  • Pensamento analítico e forte capacidade de resolução de problemas;
  • Proatividade e senso de dono sobre as soluções;
  • Colaboração com times multidisciplinares;
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos e em constante evolução;
  • Interesse por inovação, dados e novas tecnologias;
  • Organização e autonomia na gestão do trabalho.

title: Senior NodeJS Developer
description:
Senior Node.js Developer

Location: Brazil (preferred)

Contract / Contract-to-Hire | Immediate Start

We’re looking for a Senior Node.js Developer to join a fast-growing engineering team working on regulated financial platforms across LATAM.


This is an urgent, high-impact hire. You’ll be joining at a critical stage, helping to deliver key product milestones and scale secure, high-availability systems in a regulated environment.

If you enjoy ownership, autonomy, and building systems that genuinely matter - this role is for you.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building and scaling backend services using Node.js
  • Deploying and managing applications in Kubernetes
  • Working with MongoDB in production environments
  • Contributing to cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS)
  • Identifying technical risks and proactively solving them
  • Collaborating closely with product and engineering stakeholders


What We’re Looking For

  • 5–8+ years of backend development experience
  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js (essential)
  • Experience with Kubernetes and containerised environments
  • Solid knowledge of MongoDB
  • Experience with Azure or AWS (nice to have)
  • Comfortable working in regulated or high-availability environments


More importantly, we’re looking for someone who:

  • Takes ownership
  • Communicates clearly
  • Thinks ahead and manages risk
  • Works independently
  • Thrives in fast-paced teams


Experience in Financial Services, Open Finance, or Banking is a plus.

  • Local de trabalho: Bairro Butantã, próximo ao metrô

title: Gestor de Tráfego
description:
Já conhece a Galgar Digital?


Somos uma Assessoria de Marketing Digital focada em alta performance, desenvolvemos uma área digital e comercial no cliente facilitando o aumento de vendas e crescimento do negócio.


Aqui, você irá trabalhar com um time apaixonado por desafios, focado no atendimento personalizado aos nossos clientes e em busca dos melhores resultados em suas entregas. Quer mais? Tudo isso em um ambiente descontraído e com uma galera que é referência no mercado de Marketing!


Estamos em busca de um Gestor, com sólida experiência em tráfego pago, para integrar nossa equipe! O candidato ideal terá a missão de planejar, executar e otimizar campanhas que alavanquem o crescimento dos nossos clientes. Se você tem habilidades comprovadas em mídia paga e profundo conhecimento das tendências de marketing digital, queremos conhecer você!


Responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver e executar estratégias digitais completas, com foco em campanhas de tráfego pago para aumentar a visibilidade e as conversões dos clientes;


  • Gerenciar campanhas de mídia paga em plataformas como Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, LinkedIn Ads, entre outras;


  • Monitorar o desempenho das campanhas, realizar testes A/B e otimizar táticas para maximizar o ROI;


  • Colaborar com a equipe de criação para garantir que os anúncios sejam atraentes e alinhados com a identidade das marcas;


  • Analisar dados de campanhas e gerar relatórios com insights e recomendações para os clientes;


  • Agendar reuniões de acesso e resultados com clientes e equipe;


  • Responder dúvidas sobre tráfego e desempenho nos grupos de WhatsApp dos clientes do seu squad;


  • Gerenciar o orçamento de mídia paga, garantindo que os gastos estejam alinhados aos objetivos do cliente.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada como Estrategista Digital, Gestor de Tráfego ou função similar.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Google Ads, Facebook Ads e outras plataformas de anúncios.
  • Experiência em análise de dados e uso de ferramentas como Google Analytics, SEMrush, HubSpot.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar múltiplos projetos.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade para apresentar resultados aos clientes.
  • Conhecimento em SEO e marketing de conteúdo é um diferencial.


O que oferecemos:


- Contrato PJ: R$ 2.500,00 (Inicial)

- Trabalho Remoto

- Acesso a cursos e mentorias

- Brindes e vouchers por reconhecimento


#Etapas do nosso processo seletivo:


✍ Inscrição

✅ Teste Prático (Copie e cole em seu navegador, os links abaixo)

Entrevista (Videochamada)

title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts


Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently


Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines


Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • HTML/CSS knowledge for basic landing page customization
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Analista de Remuneração e Benefícios
description:
A Volkswagen Caminhões e Ônibus tem mais de 40 anos de experiência no mercado de veículos comerciais, entregando mais valor para nossos clientes e concessionários com o desenvolvimento de produtos de alta qualidade com soluções de serviços sustentáveis e inovadores.


Cultivamos uma cultura de muita parceria, aprendizados e respeito aos nossos colaboradores e parceiros do consórcio modular.


Nossos valores são a nossa base: Cliente em primeiro lugar, Respeito, Espírito de Equipe, Responsabilidade e Eliminação de desperdícios.


E o nosso propósito resume a nossa essência: \"Nós desenvolvemos soluções de transporte sustentável para todos.\"


Responsabilidades e atribuições


Organização:

Planejar e manter a estrutura organizacional corporativa, garantindo aderência à estratégia da companhia e às diretrizes globais, por meio da análise contínua de organogramas, cadeias de reporte e dimensionamento das equipes, visando assegurar eficiência e coerência estrutural.

Conduzir processos de Job Evaluation utilizando metodologias como Mercer IPE, WTW GGS ou similares, realizando entrevistas, avaliações e análises técnicas para garantir equidade interna e competitividade externa.

Suportar o processo de governança de posições no SAP SuccessFactors, garantindo criação, movimentação e encerramento conforme políticas internas, assegurando integridade de dados e compliance organizacional.

Desenvolver e validar descrições de cargos, em parceria com gestores e áreas clientes, garantindo padronização, clareza das responsabilidades e consistência com as avaliações de cargos.

Participar e apoiar projetos estruturantes de organização (revisões organizacionais, redesenho estrutural, integração de áreas, fusões, spin-offs), realizando análises qualitativas e quantitativas para suportar decisões executivas.

Criar e atualizar organogramas corporativos e funcionais, validando alinhamento entre estrutura matricial, hierarquias funcionais e reportes globais/local.

Atuar em fóruns e workstreams de Organização dentro do grupo TRATON, compartilhando melhores práticas e contribuindo com iniciativas estratégicas globais.


Remuneração:

Apoiar a manutenção e atualização da política de remuneração, alinhada à estratégia organizacional.

Apoiar a condução de pesquisas salariais e análises de competitividade externa.

Acompanhar e analisar movimentações salariais (promoções, mérito, ajustes, etc.).

Suportar os ciclos de remuneração variável (PLR, bônus, incentivos de curto e longo prazo).

Gerar relatórios e dashboards analíticos por meio do SAP SuccessFactors.

Participar dos workstreams relacionados a Comp&Ben dentro do grupo TRATON.

Apresentar novas propostas alinhadas às tendências de mercado.


Benefícios:

Suportar a administração dos benefícios oferecidos aos colaboradores (assistência médica, odontológica, vale-alimentação, transporte, entre outros).

Apoiar em campanhas de comunicação interna e programas de bem-estar.

Utilizar o SAP SuccessFactors para gestão cadastral e indicadores de adesão aos programas.

Acompanhar as pesquisas de benefícios.

Apresentar soluções estratégicas amparado nas tendências de mercado para manutenção da satisfação dos colaboradores.

title: Partner Strategy & Management Manager
description:
At Keeta, we are building the future of food delivery in Brazil. As part of Meituan’s global ecosystem, our mission is clear: help people eat better and live better.


We are looking for a Partner Strategy & Ecosystem Manager to architect and scale our partner ecosystem. This is a strategic role responsible for designing commercial frameworks, performance systems, and lifecycle processes that enable partners to grow while strengthening platform performance.


About the Role


In this role, you will define how Keeta structures, incentivizes, manages, and scales Sales BPO. You will balance commercial objectives with partner enablement, ensuring sustainable growth across the marketplace.

You will act as the strategic bridge between partners and internal stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities


Partner Strategy & Process Framework

• Design comprehensive partner strategies, including commercial models and incentive structures

• Develop partnership economics that balance growth and profitability

• Optimize compensation and performance frameworks aligned with market dynamics


End to End Partner Lifecycle

• Build scalable onboarding, training, and enablement processes

• Define recruitment, evaluation, and transition standards

• Create structured frameworks for ongoing partner support


Performance Management & Execution

• Develop and implement partner performance evaluation systems

• Analyze performance results and drive improvement initiatives

• Translate strategic priorities into clear execution plans for partner managers


Settlement & Operational Excellence

• Execute partner settlement processes with accuracy and timeliness

• Identify opportunities to improve settlement efficiency and transparency

• Partner with Product to enhance systems and workflow automation


Requirements

• Experience in food delivery, e-commerce, marketplace, or on demand services

• Experience building scalable partner lifecycle processes

• Strong analytical skills with Excel, SQL, or BI tools

• Advanced English proficiency for cross border collaboration

• Availability to work on site in São Paulo


Why Join Keeta

• Shape the strategic foundation of Keeta’s partner ecosystem in Brazil

• High ownership and visibility from day one

• International exposure with global collaboration

• Startup speed combined with global scale support


If you are excited about building scalable partner ecosystems, designing commercial strategies, and driving marketplace growth, we would love to hear from you.

#Keeta #EatBetterLiveBetter #PartnerStrategy #Marketplace #CommercialStrategy #EcosystemGrowth

title: Director of Business Development
description:
About the Company:

Burning Rock Dx. (NASDAQ: BNR) was founded in 2014 and specialized in providing Next- Generation Sequencing (NGS) products and services to support the whole process of the precision medicine development cycle. Burning Rock Dx. is headquartered in Guangzhou, China, and has precision medicine laboratories and offices in Guangzhou, Beijing, Shanghai, and US California, employing more than 1,000 people worldwide. Its business currently covers over 30 provinces and autonomous regions in China, the United States and Europe.

About the Role:

The ideal candidate will direct the business development activities of the organization and drive the sales business. They play a key role in the company and in the generation of new business. This individual will also be responsible for managing marketing and customer service activities.


Responsibilities:

 Actively prospect and leverage potential new business opportunities within specified potential new and/or existing customers in LATAM market;

 Develop new business and regulatory plan for the LATAM market, and achieve operation plan objectives;

 Identify opportunities from marketing leads, communicating with and managing local business partners;

 Understanding the market information and reporting to company headquarter in a timely manner;

 Collaborate with other departments to set up necessary operational process for the LATAM market;

 Building up the brand awareness of the company and its product solutions in the LATAM market;

 Provide excellent customer service by following through with prompt solutions to all customer inquiries.

Qualifications:

 Minimum of 5 years of working experience in BD, or sales function for molecular pathology, or IVD related product market;

 BS or MS degree in Life & Science, Molecular Pathology or Clinical Medicine, MBA and/or PhD a plus;

 Good knowledge about local molecular pathology market, International and multi- cultural experience is preferred;

 Excellent communication and presentation skills;

 Ability to think strategically and creatively while executing methodically with high attention to details and operational excellence;

 Energetic with strong motivation to find new business opportunity speedy;

 Familiar with the business model of selling imported products/services in the Middle east;

 Fluent in working English.


Equal Opportunity Statement:

It is the policy of Burning Rock Dx LLC to provide equal employment and advancement opportunities to all colleagues and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, gender, pregnancy/childbirth, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability or perceived disability, genetic information, citizenship, veteran or military status or a person’s relationship or association with a protected veteran, including spouses and other family members, marital or domestic partner status, or any other category protected by federal, state and/or local laws. As an equal opportunity employer, Burning Rock Dx LLC is committed to a diverse workforce.

title: React Application Architect
description:
About You

You are an Application Architect specializing in marketing technology and digital analytics platforms. title: Finance Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
  • Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
  • Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
  • Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.
  • Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.
  • Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.
  • Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet.


Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
  • Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.g., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.
  • Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

title: DevOps Sr
description:
O Inatel está recrutando Especialista para atuar como DevOps, no ICC SOFT.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Realizar a atualização de sistemas (deployment) utilizando tecnologia específica do projeto;
  • Desenvolver scripts de alta complexidade para automatização de deployment do projeto ou qualquer outra tarefa que o projeto julgue necessária sua automatização;
  • Realizar monitoramento de sistemas e aplicações utilizando tecnologia definida no projeto, analisar de a alta complexidade em dados obtidos, e realizar configurações complexas na ferramenta;
  • Definir arquitetura em termos de documentação e tecnologia;
  • Utilizar plataformas de computação em nuvem e provisionar recursos e serviços básicos de cloud, de forma manual e automatizada;
  • Desenvolver ferramentas web de complexidade média para uso interno do projeto;
  • Documentar processos e soluções técnicas de acordo com as necessidades do projeto;
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes críticos de software e infraestrutura no sistema;
  • Realizar automatização de processo de Build;
  • Analisar e isolar o defeito apontado no processo de testes da solução, bem como identificar a causa raiz e propor uma solução a fim de atender aos processos de qualidade de software;
  • Criar documentações complementares de acordo com as necessidades do projeto;
  • Aplicar novos procedimentos de desenvolvimento de software, conforme necessidade, descrevendo métodos e operacionalização dos mesmos, em sequência padronizada, de acordo com o sistema de qualidade assegurada, a fim de buscar melhorias contínuas;
  • Atuar como agente multiplicador de conhecimentos, prestando suporte técnico ao time.


Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino superior completo, preferencialmente em cursos de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou Ciência da Computação;


Forte compreensão de arquiteturas nativas de nuvem (cloud-native), incluindo Kubernetes, microsserviços e malha de serviços (service mesh);


Domínio em:

  • Ferramentas para deployment (ex: Jenkings, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, Travis CI, Salt),
  • Plataformas de computação em nuvem (ex: AWS, Openstack, Google Cloud),
  • Criação de scripts em Shell Script, Python ou PHP,
  • Automatização de cloud (ex: Terraform, Cloud Formation),
  • Infraestrutura como Código,
  • Linguagem de programação para automatização de testes (ex: Selenium, Javascript, Phanton JS, Casper JS),
  • Ferramentas de controle de versão (Ex.:GIT, Gerrit),
  • Lógica de Programação;


Conhecimentos em:

  • Ferramentas Grafana, Graphite, ELK,

title: Técnico Suporte ao Usuário
description:
Sobre nós


A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Sobre a Vaga:


Técnico de Suporte ao Usuário JR

Horário de trabalho: 15:40 a 01:10 - segunda à sexta-feira


Modalidade presencial em Itaúna, MG.


O profissional será responsável pelo suporte técnico de TI presencial na área de manufatura da Stellantis, atuando diretamente no atendimento aos usuários, bem como na montagem, manutenção preventiva e corretiva de equipamentos de TI. A posição é dedicada à operação fabril, garantindo a disponibilidade, estabilidade e funcionamento adequado dos recursos tecnológicos utilizados na produção.


️ Responsabilidades

Atendimento presencial aos usuários da manufatura.

Montagem, configuração e manutenção preventiva e corretiva de desktops, notebooks e impressoras.

Instalação, formatação e atualização de sistemas operacionais.

Instalação e configuração de softwares corporativos.

Execução de backup e restauração de dados conforme procedimentos definidos.

Diagnóstico e resolução de incidentes relacionados a hardware e software.

Abertura, acompanhamento e encerramento de chamados via ferramenta ITSM.

Apoio técnico em salas de produção e áreas administrativas da planta.

Suporte em atividades de troca, substituição e preparação de equipamentos (imaging, setup e testes).


Requisitos Obrigatórios

Experiência comprovada em suporte técnico de TI (hardware e software).

Vivência com montagem e manutenção de computadores e notebooks.

Experiência com impressoras (instalação, manutenção básica e troubleshooting).

Conhecimento em sistemas operacionais Windows.

Experiência com atendimento ao usuário e uso de ferramenta de chamados (ITSM).

Boa comunicação, organização e senso de prioridade.


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

Experiência em ambiente de manufatura ou indústria.

Vivência com backup e restore de dados.

Conhecimentos em redes básicas (TCP/IP, mapeamento de rede, impressoras em rede).

Cursando ou formado em TI ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimento em ferramentas como ServiceNow, SCCM, ou similares.

title: Quality Engineer (QE) — Automação- Sênior
description:
Estamos buscando um profissional com sólida experiência em automação e qualidade de software. Procuramos alguém tecnicamente forte em Playwright, testes de front-end e API, e familiarizado com práticas modernas de QA, como shift-left testing e Gherkin.

Se você gosta de evoluir frameworks de automação e contribuir para a cultura de qualidade de múltiplas squads, esta vaga é para você.


Junte-se a um time orientado à inovação, focado em excelência de automação e qualidade, sob a liderança de um Coordenador de Engenharia de QA experiente.


O que você irá fazer:

* Desenvolver, executar e manter testes automatizados (foco em APIs e serviços/microserviços).

* Especificar e implementar cenários seguindo BDD com Gherkin.

* Registrar, organizar e rastrear cenários, evidências e resultados no Xray (Gherkin).

* Garantir cobertura e eficácia com técnicas de teste de caixa preta e caixa branca.

* Integrar automação aos pipelines de CI/CD (ex.: Jenkins), garantindo execução recorrente e confiável.

* Realizar smoke testing e identificar rapidamente falhas críticas.

* Validar fluxos síncronos e assíncronos, incluindo cenários com mensageria (AWS SQS) quando aplicável.

* Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento, produto e operações para qualidade ponta a ponta.

* Utilizar Docker para provisionamento de ambientes de teste e execução de pipelines automatizados.

* Apoiar investigação de falhas utilizando observabilidade (traces/métricas/logs), quando necessário.


O que esperamos de você:

* Experiência sólida com Playwright (automação).

* Experiência com Gherkin (BDD) e uso do Xray com Gherkin.

* Profundo entendimento de APIs (validação de payloads, autenticação, contratos, timeouts, retries, etc.).

* Experiência com CI/CD e integração de testes em pipelines (ex.: Jenkins).

* Conhecimento em Docker e ambientes conteinerizados.

* Familiaridade com testes em ambientes distribuídos / microserviços.

* Domínio de técnicas de teste de caixa preta e caixa branca.

* Vivência com smoke testing.

* Programação (principalmente JavaScript) — obrigatório e eliminatório.


Desejável:

* Experiência com validação de fluxos assíncronos e tópicos de mensageria (SQS/DLQ/reprocessamento).

* Noções de Kubernetes/EKS para troubleshooting básico de execuções (logs/health checks).

* Experiência com observabilidade (Dynatrace / OpenTelemetry / Grafana Loki) para diagnóstico e redução de testes instáveis (“flaky tests”).

* Experiência com testes de performance e segurança.

* Conhecimento em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).

* Noções de Terraform (para entendimento de ambientes e limitações de infraestrutura).



A OSF Digital tem orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais, onde você pode ser você mesmo no trabalho. Junte-se a uma comunidade inclusiva e apaixonada de profissionais que ajudam a promover a transformação digital para empresas ao redor do mundo. Na OSF Digital, acolhemos todas as pessoas e não discriminamos com base em identidade e expressão de gênero, raça, etnia, deficiência, orientação sexual, cor, religião, origem nacional, idade, estado civil ou qualquer outra categoria protegida em qualquer jurisdição onde atuamos.

title: Analytics Manager
description:
Senior Operations Data Analyst

100% Remote (Brazil-Based) | US-Based Company | Paid in USD/hour


We are hiring for a leading US-based luxury resale and eCommerce company transforming how high-end fashion is bought and sold globally.


We are looking for a Senior Operations Data Analyst with a strong analytics mindset, solid SQL expertise, and proven experience working closely with business teams. This is a high-impact role focused on operational performance, business clarity, and strategic decision-making.


About the Role


You will deliver quantitative insights to support our Operations organization, partnering closely with teams across:


  • Inventory
  • Logistics
  • Retail
  • Customer Service
  • Tech & Finance


This is a business-focused analytics role, not pure research or advanced modeling. The day-to-day work includes:


  • Explaining performance changes (“why did this move?”)
  • Turning open-ended business questions into structured analysis
  • Designing and defining KPIs
  • Measuring operational efficiency across receiving, authentication, launch, and outbound workflows
  • Translating business needs into technical solutions

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Sr. Backend Engineer (Node.js)
description:
About You

You are a senior-level Backend Engineer (Node.js) who thrives in challenging environments and enjoys taking ownership of complex systems to transform them into secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions.


You are highly hands-on and comfortable working with evolving or partially structured codebases. You can quickly assess risks, identify critical issues, and execute remediation strategies under tight timelines. You value clean code, security best practices, and reliable system behavior.


You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical challenges clearly, and play a key role in stabilizing applications and restoring confidence in production systems. You are motivated by making a tangible impact and contributing to the successful relaunch and future scalability of a critical platform.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in backend development using Node.js.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong experience working with REST APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Proven experience handling legacy systems, codebase audits, or technical recovery scenarios.
  • Solid understanding of application security best practices, including secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS environments and services.
  • Experience setting up or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong experience working with PostgreSQL databases (RDS preferred).
  • Familiarity with proxies, CORS, and common web security vulnerabilities (e.g., SSRF).
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments with ambiguous or incomplete documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize issues based on business impact.
  • Experience collaborating with mobile teams (React Native is a plus).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of the Node.js backend and perform a full technical assessment of the codebase.
  • Identify and remediate critical security vulnerabilities and insecure integrations.
  • Refactor unstable or low-quality code to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Stabilize core application flows required for production readiness.
  • Re-establish codebase ownership by organizing and migrating repositories within the client environment.
  • Analyze and restore CI/CD pipelines across repositories and environments.
  • Set up and validate staging environments to support testing and release processes.
  • Audit and stabilize third-party integrations such as payments and external platforms.
  • Collaborate with QA and stakeholders to validate functionality and prioritize fixes.
  • Support release readiness and launch execution ensuring system stability.
  • Enforce a feature-freeze approach focused on stabilization and critical fixes.
  • Contribute to defining a post-launch roadmap to support scalability and future development.
  • Continuously improve system security, performance, and operational stability.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Node.js backend development.
  • Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects.
  • Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations.
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: SAP Basis
description:
Localização:

Remoto

Tipo de Contrato:

PJ

Sobre a Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional sênior com experiência em SAP BASIS para integrar a equipe do nosso cliente. Nesta função, você contribuirá com a assessoria em questões de arquitetura técnica, suporte em situações críticas e participação em atividades de lançamento e manutenção.

Responsabilidades

  • Assessorar clientes em questões de arquitetura técnica e paisagem.
  • Suportar a desescalada de situações críticas de clientes, trabalhando com equipes relevantes da SAP.
  • Participar de atividades de lançamento e manutenção de clientes.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico contínuo e transferência de conhecimento.
  • Revisar o status da conta e transitar contas à medida que o volume ou a complexidade aumenta.

Requisitos

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em SAP Basis.
  • 2 anos de conhecimento em nuvem (gestão de soluções, consultoria ou gestão de programas de entrega).
  • Experiência prática com Aplicação S/4 HANA e banco de dados HANA.
  • Experiência obrigatória em Upgrade & Migração SAP (OS/DB).

Qualificações Desejáveis

  • Experiência na integração de produtos SaaS (ex.: Ariba, Salesforce, C4S) com o ambiente SAP é um diferencial.
  • Experiência com qualquer hyperscaler (AWS, Azure ou GCP).

Quem Somos

Talento onde você precisa, quando você precisa! A SGF Global é uma provedora líder de soluções especializadas em talentos, dedicada a conectar profissionais altamente qualificados com oportunidades em diversos setores. Oferecemos soluções de contratação para posições temporárias, permanentes e de contrato para efetivação em áreas como tecnologia, finanças e contabilidade, engenharia, marketing e criação, serviços jurídicos, suporte administrativo e ao cliente, energia, petróleo e gás, telecomunicações, manufatura, aeroespacial, ciências da vida, mineração e utilidades.

Na SGF Global, trabalhamos para colocá-lo na melhor posição para ter sucesso. Oferecemos acesso a posições de alto nível, remuneração competitiva, benefícios atrativos e treinamentos online gratuitos. Fique por dentro de todas as oportunidades, a qualquer momento — mesmo em movimento.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Company:

Our client is a leading provider of org chart automation and workforce planning software that empowers HR professionals and the people leaders they support. To support our fast-growing team, we are hiring a Software Support Specialist who enjoys solving problems, helping customers succeed, and working closely with a team that cares deeply about the product and the people who use it.

In this role, you will work directly with customers to help them get the most value out of our client’s SaaS platform. You will troubleshoot issues, guide users through configuration and best practices, and partner with internal teams to improve both the product and the customer experience.

This is a hands-on role in a collaborative team where curiosity, ownership, and a growth mindset are valued. If you enjoy technology, learning new systems, and turning complex problems into clear solutions for customers, you will thrive here.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide technical support for web-based platform, helping customers resolve issues and use the product effectively
  • Work directly with customers to configure our product and guide them through best practices for importing and managing organizational data
  • Investigate and resolve support tickets with a focus on timely, thoughtful communication and a positive client experience
  • Collaborate with internal teams to escalate and resolve complex issues
  • Identify patterns in support requests and provide feedback that helps improve the product and documentation
  • Contribute to internal knowledge bases and help refine support processes as the company grows


Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of experience supporting web-based applications or SaaS platforms
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to diagnose technical issues clearly and efficiently
  • Comfort working directly with customers and explaining technical concepts in a clear, approachable way
  • Curiosity and a growth mindset, with the ability to quickly learn new technologies and systems
  • Self-motivation and ownership in identifying problems and improving processes
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work across teams to find solutions
  • Sound judgment and attention to detail

title: Consultor(a) AMS - SAP MM Guepardo
description:
Make this the place where you grow!


Como NTT DATA Business Solutions, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa. Somos uma equipe de pessoas apaixonadas que impulsionam a inovação – desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e muito mais. Com a SAP no nosso núcleo e um poderoso ecossistema de parceiros como Microsoft e ServiceNow, continuamos aprimorando soluções e tecnologias baseadas em IA para que funcionem para as empresas – e para suas pessoas.


Fazemos parte da NTT DATA, líder de US$ 30+ bilhões em serviços empresariais e tecnológicos, IA e infraestrutura digital, atendendo 75% da Fortune Global 100. Co-inovamos soluções com clientes e parceiros globalmente para impacto empresarial e social. Como um dos principais empregadores globais, a NTT DATA conta com especialistas em mais de 70 países. A NTT DATA faz parte do Grupo NTT.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) Pleno AMS – SAP MM para atuar no suporte funcional e evolutivo do software Guepardo E‑Invoicing , integrando o time de AMS na NTT DATA.

Você será responsável por garantir a sustentação, melhorias contínuas e o adequado funcionamento dos processos INBOUND e OUTBOUND no sistema proprietário da NTT DATA, além de atuar em integração com áreas fiscais, técnicas e demais stakeholders.



Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar no suporte funcional e evolutivo do Guepardo E‑Invoicing e Guepardo Tax.
  • Atender chamados de incidentes, problemas, requisições e melhorias, dentro dos SLAs estabelecidos.
  • Analisar e solucionar demandas relacionadas ao módulo Guepardo E‑Invoicing.
  • Utilizar conhecimentos em SAP MM e SD para identificar e tratar problemas relacionados ao fluxo de documentos.
  • Apoiar integrações entre SAP e soluções fiscais, garantindo aderência às exigências legais brasileiras.
  • Participar de especificações funcionais, testes integrados e validações com áreas de negócio.
  • Contribuir com melhorias contínuas nos processos e sistemas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times técnicos, fiscais e de projeto, promovendo alinhamento e eficiência operacional.



Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida no módulo SAP MM, atuando com suporte AMS.
  • Vivência em sustentação e melhorias evolutivas.
  • Conhecimento em processos de compras, cadastro de materiais, gestão de estoque e movimentações.
  • Experiência ou vivência com SAP GRC e módulos correlatos.
  • Noções de legislação fiscal e impostos (ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS e outros).
  • Perfil analítico, boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalho em equipe.



Diferenciais:

  • Formação em TI, Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Ciência da Computação ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Interesse pela legislação tributária brasileira e seus desdobramentos práticos.
  • Inglês intermediário.



Regime de Contratação: Modelo de CLT

100% Remoto



Somos a maior empresa de consultoria SAP do mundo para empresas de médio porte. Torne-se um especialista trabalhando em grandes projetos. Com as parcerias SAP Platinum, Microsoft e AWS, impulsionamos a inovação e adotamos novas tecnologias. Com a nossa visão e ambição, entregamos desempenho de alta performance.



*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora | C# - Asp Net
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


DESAFIO


  • Participar do desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações web utilizando ASP.NET, C#, JavaScript, e outras tecnologias relacionadas.
  • Implementar e otimizar soluções utilizando HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, e JSon, garantindo alta performance e usabilidade.
  • Desenvolver e manter banco de dados SQL Server, incluindo a criação e otimização de triggers, stored procedures e aplicação de regras de normalização.
  • Integrar e consumir WebServices (SOAP e REST) nas aplicações desenvolvidas.
  • Controlar as mudanças no desenvolvimento de software para assegurar a estabilidade e evolução contínua dos projetos.
  • Identificar e corrigir problemas no código, bem como propor melhorias e oportunidades de refatoração para manter a qualidade do software.
  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para garantir que as soluções atendam aos requisitos de negócios e qualidade.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA


  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Entendimento de processos de desenvolvimento, qualidade e maturidade de software.
  • Experiência e conhecimento em Linguagem de programação: domínio de aplicação e entendimento de sintaxe e desempenho de linguagens como ASP.NET c#, Java script, Json, Bootstrap
  • Experiência com WEB JS/Jquery/Ajax, Webforms, Bootstrap, HTML, JSon e CSS, SQL Server, incluindo normalização, triggers, e stored procedures.
  • Conhecimento em SOAP e REST.
  • Habilidade analítica para detectar problemas e propor soluções eficazes.
  • Proatividade e boa comunicação para colaborar com diferentes equipes.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER


  • Experiência prévia no mercado de corretoras de seguros.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PRA VOCÊ


️ Auxílio Alimentação : para você escolher suas refeições com liberdade.

Auxílio Creche: Para ajudar nas despesas dos pequenos.

Assistência Médica SulAmérica : Cuidado completo para você e sua família.

title: SAP Cloud Architect - SAP Basis
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Are you an experienced SAP Basis Consultant ready to take the next step in your career? Join our Cloud Architect Advisory (CAA) team as a SAP Cloud Architect, where you'll guide customers through their SAP RISE journey and shape the future of enterprise landscapes.


About the Role


As a SAP Cloud Architect, you’ll be the strategic advisor for customers transitioning to the SAP RISE platform. This customer-facing role involves planning, designing, and presenting SAP landscape architectures tailored to each client’s needs and hyperscaler preferences (AWS, Azure, GCP). You’ll collaborate closely with SAP Sales and Account Executives to ensure technical accuracy and optimal design.


Note: This is a purely architectural role—no hands-on implementation required.


What You’ll Gain


Exposure to cutting-edge SAP technologies: S/4HANA, HANA DB, MDG, Ariba, Salesforce, and more.

Access to SAP’s internal training and learning resources.

Experience across multiple industries and customer landscapes.

A unique opportunity to work on diverse architecture setups not typically available in standard SAP Basis roles.

title: Social Media Growth Strategist
description:
Job Title: Social Media Growth Strategist

About the Company:

Our Client is a dynamic company focused on leveraging digital platforms to drive brand engagement and growth. They specialize in creating innovative social media strategies to enhance visibility and interaction across various channels.

Job Description:

Our client is seeking a Social Media Growth Strategist to lead and execute high-performance growth initiatives for their Instagram presence. This role is focused on scaling audience growth through data-driven strategies, performance analysis, and systematic content experimentation. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of rapidly scaling Instagram accounts, understands platform algorithms deeply, and uses analytics, testing, and optimization to consistently drive follower growth and engagement.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute data-driven Instagram growth strategies aimed at scaling the account by 5,000+ followers per month.
  • Analyze performance metrics to continuously optimize content strategy, timing, and format.
  • Design and run content experiments (hooks, formats, topics, posting cadence) to identify scalable growth patterns.
  • Use AI tools and analytics platforms to generate insights, content ideas, and performance improvements.
  • Oversee and manage the content publishing pipeline, ensuring consistent and strategic posting.
  • Collaborate with designers, editors, and content creators to produce high-performing Reels, carousels, and short-form content.
  • Repurpose and adapt content across platforms (Instagram, X, and others) to maximize reach.
  • Monitor trends, algorithm updates, and competitive accounts to identify new growth opportunities.
  • Track KPIs and report on growth metrics, engagement rates, and audience acquisition performance.

Required Experience and Qualifications:

  • Proven experience scaling Instagram accounts with measurable results.
  • Demonstrated ability to grow accounts by 5K+ followers per month or more through organic strategies.
  • Strong understanding of Instagram algorithms, Reels optimization, virality mechanics, and audience growth tactics.
  • Experience using data and analytics to guide content and growth strategy.
  • Comfortable leveraging AI tools for ideation, research, and content production workflows.
  • Highly organized with strong execution and performance tracking skills.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience managing high-growth or influencer-level social media accounts.
  • Experience with A/B testing content strategies and viral content frameworks.
  • Background in multimedia content production or creative direction.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills when working with creative teams.

Personality:

  • Analytical and data-driven mindset.
  • Creative strategist with a strong understanding of viral content mechanics.
  • Highly proactive and results-oriented.
  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-growth digital environment.

Software & Tools:

  • Instagram analytics and social media scheduling platforms.
  • AI content generation tools.
  • Performance tracking and analytics tools.

Schedule:

9-5 EST

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.


About The Opportunity


We are looking for a Salesforce Developer to join a team responsible for evolving and optimizing a Salesforce Service Cloud environment. In this role, you will collaborate with Salesforce engineers, administrators, and business stakeholders to design, develop, and deploy solutions that improve operational processes and platform adoption. You will work with both declarative configurations and custom development to support Customer Experience initiatives and scalable Salesforce capabilities.


Responsibilities


  • Design and implement solutions using Salesforce Service Cloud, leveraging both declarative features and custom development.
  • Develop custom functionality using Apex, Lightning Components, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Configure, enhance, and maintain standard and custom Salesforce capabilities to support the CX team, including custom objects, workflows, Process Builder, Lightning Flows, sharing rules, email alerts, quick actions, and Embedded Service chat deployments.
  • Support integrations, platform enhancements, and new feature development.
  • Manage code deployments across multiple environments.
  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards to support business insights.
  • Contribute to the documentation of Salesforce configurations and integrations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions for customer experience operations.


Required Qualifications


  • Strong experience working with Salesforce development and configuration.
  • Proficiency with Apex, JavaScript, SOQL, SOSL, Lightning Components, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Experience working with Salesforce automation tools, reporting, and dashboards.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to work effectively in collaborative environments with tight timelines.
  • Background in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related fields.


Nice To Have Skills


  • Experience supporting customer experience (CX) or service operations teams.
  • Familiarity with community portals or help center implementations.
  • Salesforce certifications.


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
About:

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Architect, design, and implement backend systems and APIs using Java (Spring Boot/Spring Cloud) for AI-driven applications.
  • Collaborate with data science and ML teams to integrate machine learning models and pipelines into scalable backend services.
  • Develop and optimize microservices, ensuring low latency and high availability.
  • Implement data ingestion, transformation, and model-serving workflows in coordination with ML engineers.
  • Ensure seamless deployment of ML models through API endpoints and containerized environments.
  • Apply best practices for security, scalability, and reliability across distributed systems.
  • Optimize backend services for performance and cost efficiency in cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure).
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams on CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and infrastructure as code.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (AI/ML specialization a plus).
  • 7+ years of professional backend development experience with Java.
  • Strong proficiency in Java (8 or higher) and frameworks such as Spring Boot or Spring Cloud .
  • Experience with RESTful API design , microservices architecture , and event-driven systems .
  • Solid understanding of SQL/NoSQL databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure.
  • Proficient in Git , CI/CD pipelines , and containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Understanding of Agile development principles and version control best practices.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with MLOps practices and CI/CD for ML pipelines.
  • Contributions to AI/ML-related open-source projects or research experience.


Benefits

- Full-time remote working within an international environment

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Support Specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub. 


Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!



About the opportunity

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

﻿This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. 




We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?



Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.

    • Skills & Qualifications:
    • Technical Expertise:
    • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
    • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
    • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
    • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
    • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
    • Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
    • Problem-solving Ability:
    • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
    • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
    • Communication Skills:
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
    • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
    • Organizational Skills:
    • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.



    Preferred Experience:
    • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
    • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
    • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
    • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
    • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
    • Previous work with an American company
    Education & Certifications:
    • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
    • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
    • Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.


    Who You Are:

    • A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
    • You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
    • Passion for helping others internally and externally 
    • Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
    • In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

title: Support Specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub. 


Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!



About the opportunity

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

﻿This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. 




We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?



Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.
